Search-only character folding uses the unmodified TSCharacters dictionary
from opencc-js 1.4.2 (https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js), published under MIT.
The dictionary is derived from opencc-data (https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-data),
published under Apache-2.0. License texts accompany this file.

Only the character dictionary is included; no phrase conversion is performed.
Folding is used for book/contents search comparisons, never to rewrite book text.
